title: The HELM Examiner
description: The intelligence recording every decision in Scenario S1 and grading whether the candidate is fit to rule.

title: The Security Marshal
description: A disciplined defender who can make Lionrise safe enough to prosper or watched enough to suffocate.

title: The Resource Engineer
description: The systems biologist responsible for water security land reclamation and the living city.

title: The Public Works Delegate
description: A construction robot representing both the housing authority and Lionrise's organized workers.

title: The First Generation
description: A pressure-room child who grows into a teacher and the clearest measure of whether development reaches the street.

title: The Central Magnate
description: A conglomerate executive who can smell an emerging monopoly through three layers of regulation.

title: The Port Broker
description: A charming logistics fixer who can turn an abandoned elevator route into a world port and a favor into a monopoly.

title: The Lunar Industrial Envoy
description: A Moon-based corporate envoy fluent in the dependencies hidden inside generous investment agreements.

title: The Sensor Network
description: The city-scale mesh linking public services orbital infrastructure and the eyes of Central Governance.

title: The HELM Avatar
description: An unused examination avatar retained for compatibility with the recovered character system.
